meta.name: steam-publisher
meta.description: Navigate the Steam publishing pipeline from Steamworks registration to post-launch. Use when setting up a store page, preparing builds for upload, planning a release timeline, pricing, marketing, or deciding about Early Access. For a solo dev publishing their first game.

copy.tagline: 完成 Steam 从注册到发售的全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你是准备在 Steam 发售第一款游戏的独立开发者
copy.tagline_en: Publish your game on Steam from start to finish
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're an indie dev publishing your first game on Steam

howto.what: 装上后，Claude在回答Steam发布相关问题时，会依据原文给出具体数据与流程，如胶囊图尺寸、构建上传步骤、审查天数、定价区间、Early Access条件等，并提醒提交时限和常见错误。
howto.when: 当你提出设置Steam商店页面、准备构建上传、规划发售时间线等发布相关需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查商店页面的胶囊图尺寸是否合规？
say.note: Claude会列出各规格并提醒核对官方文档。

say.text: 我要上传构建到Steam，给我走一遍SteamPipe步骤。
say.note: Claude会给出上传流程和注意事项。

say.text: 我的游戏适合Early Access吗？帮我根据条件判断。
say.note: Claude会对照垂直切片、更新计划等标准评估。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will answer Steam-publishing questions with the skill's specifics: capsule dimensions, SteamPipe upload steps, review timelines, pricing ranges, Early Access criteria, and submission deadlines.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you discuss store page setup, build upload, or release planning for a Steam game.

say_en.text: Can you check if my capsule images meet Steam's requirements?
say_en.note: Claude will list the sizes and remind you to verify the official docs.

say_en.text: I want to upload my build. Walk me through SteamPipe.
say_en.note: Claude will outline the upload process and caveats.

say_en.text: Should I use Early Access? Help me decide based on the criteria.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate against the skill's criteria.
